016package org.vafer.jdeb;
017
018import org.apache.commons.compress.archivers.tar.TarArchiveOutputStream;
019
020public class TarOptions {
021
022  private Compression compression = Compression.GZIP;
023  private int longFileMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.LONGFILE_GNU;
024  private int bigNumberMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.BIGNUMBER_STAR;
025
026  public TarOptions compression(Compression compression) {
027    this.compression = compression;
028
029    return this;
030  }
031
032  public TarOptions longFileMode(String input) {
033    if ("posix".equals(input)) {
034      longFileMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.LONGFILE_POSIX;
035    } else if ("error".equals(input)) {
036      longFileMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.LONGFILE_ERROR;
037    } else if ("truncate".equals(input)) {
038      longFileMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.LONGFILE_TRUNCATE;
039    } else {
040      longFileMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.LONGFILE_GNU;
041    }
042
043    return this;
044  }
045
046  public TarOptions bigNumberMode(String input) {
047    if ("error".equals(input)) {
048      bigNumberMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.BIGNUMBER_ERROR;
049    } else if ("posix".equals(input)) {
050      bigNumberMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.BIGNUMBER_POSIX;
051    } else {
052      bigNumberMode = TarArchiveOutputStream.BIGNUMBER_STAR;
053    }
054
055    return this;
056  }
057
058  public int longFileMode() {
059    return longFileMode;
060  }
061
062  public int bigNumberMode() {
063    return bigNumberMode;
064  }
065
066  public Compression compression() {
067    return compression;
068  }
069}
